'''Auto-pool''' was a table used to play a game. An auto-pool table could be found in the [[Dim-U monastery/Legends|Dim-U monastery]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GG7" />
